subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status show tool-specific progress during a run, or should OpenClaw keep the merged generic loading-message behavior as the supported native status UX?
rationale: Current main has the plumbing to observe tool starts and non-native progress, but the remaining behavior is user-facing Slack disclosure/default policy rather than a broken established contract.

options.title: Add Slack-owned tool status
options.body: Implement tool-specific native Slack status updates in the Slack plugin with conservative labels, no new core API unless required, focused tests, and live Slack proof.

options.title: Keep generic status only
options.body: Treat the merged loading-message behavior as sufficient and close or supersede tool-specific native status work after a maintainer says tool names should not be shown there.

options.title: Make it explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a documented Slack config setting for tool-specific native status only if maintainers accept the new config surface and upgrade implications.

recommendation.title: Add Slack-owned tool status
recommendation.body: Implement tool-specific native Slack status updates in the Slack plugin with conservative labels, no new core API unless required, focused tests, and live Slack proof.

likelyOwner.reason: @zimeg has the clearest symbol-history connection to Slack native assistant-thread status behavior.
